name: IMO Prelim Past Paper
statement:
Points $A$ and $B$ lie on a plane. A straight line passing through $A$ will divide
the plane into 2 regions. A further straight line through $B$ will altogether divide the plane
into 4 regions, and so on. If 1002 and 1000 straight lines are drawn passing through $A$ and
$B$ respectively, what is the maximum number of regions formed?
